description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of coins with their details including image, symbol, name, and price changes.

classes.name: CoinAdapter
classes.description: Adapter that provides views for a list of Coin items in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: CoinViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for displaying individual Coin items within the CoinAdapter.

classes.name: CoinDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback to calculate differences between two lists of Coin items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for the Coin item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the Coin item data to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds coin data to the CoinViewHolder UI components.
